detail.title: Reactivating Curiosity Frameworks for Structural Inquiry
detail.summary: We are prioritizing the reactivation of the 'Mechanisms of Curiosity' project (proj-curiosity-001) in alignment with the active research topic. By synthesizing existing evidence from current curiosity-driven learning research, we aim to address whether curiosity mechanisms can be structurally optimized to facilitate better question formulation rather than merely performance optimization.
